title: NASA-UAP-D016, Preliminary Gemini 4 Crew Debriefing, Part I, 1965

pages.description: A nearly blank, off-white or cream-colored paper page with no printed or handwritten text. Small dark ink marks or specks appear along the left edge, including a cluster near the upper-left and lower-left areas. A small dark mark is visible in the upper-right corner. Faint smudges and light shadowing appear vertically down the center and toward the edges, consistent with scanning of an aged sheet.

observations.claim: The page contains no legible printed or handwritten text
There are small dark ink specks near the left edge of the page
A small dark mark appears in the upper-right corner
The paper is off-white or cream colored with faint shadowing
